name: Open a new sub-account for a member
description: Search for a member, open a new sub-account of the given type with the given initial deposit, confirm the irreversible submission, and capture the new account number.

discovery.goal_text: For member {member_id}, open a new {account_type} sub-account with an initial deposit of {initial_deposit}. Complete the confirmation step so the account is actually created, and finish once you see the success screen showing the new account number.

input_params.name: member_id
input_params.description: The member ID to open a sub-account for.

input_params.name: account_type
input_params.description: One of Savings, Checking, or CD.

input_params.name: initial_deposit
input_params.description: Initial deposit amount, must be greater than 0.

output_params.name: account_number
output_params.description: The newly created sub-account's account number.
